departments.name: Clinical Services
departments.summary: Clinical Services provides medical care to patients and manages clinical equipment and clinician schedules.

evidence.quote: Sees patients and requests clinical equipment and supplies.
Leads the clinicians and signs off on clinical equipment.
The Clinical Director confirms the clinician's sessions and sends a roster request to Practice Operations, which adds the clinician to the clinic rosters and the booking system.

departments.name: Practice Operations
departments.summary: Practice Operations oversees clinic operations, purchasing, supplies, and clinician rostering.

evidence.quote: Runs the clinics, the rosters and purchasing, and approves the clinics' purchases.

work.task: Raising purchase requests and stocking clinics

evidence.quote: Raises purchase requests and keeps each clinic stocked.

work.task: Adding clinicians to rosters and the booking system

evidence.quote: The Clinical Director confirms the clinician's sessions and sends a roster request to Practice Operations, which adds the clinician to the clinic rosters and the booking system.

departments.name: Patient Services
departments.summary: Patient Services manages patient appointments, reception operations, fee collection, and complaints.

work.task: Handling patient complaints and reception leadership

evidence.quote: Leads reception and handles patient complaints.
Books appointments, takes payments and logs refund requests.
A Receptionist logs each refund request with the patient, the invoice number, the amount and the reason.

departments.name: People & Culture
departments.summary: People & Culture manages recruitment, onboarding, credential checking, and employment contracts.

work.task: Checking clinician registration and preparing contracts

evidence.quote: Checks new clinicians' registration and prepares their contracts.

departments.name: Finance
departments.summary: Finance manages the group's budgets, accounts, supplier disbursements, and patient refunds.

evidence.quote: Owns budgets, payments and the group's accounts.

work.task: Paying suppliers and processing patient refunds

evidence.quote: Pays suppliers and processes patient refunds.
The Accounts Officer matches it to the purchase order and pays the supplier within 30 days.
The Accounts Officer refunds the patient's card within 5 business days.
Practice Operations sends each supplier invoice to Finance.
When a clinician accepts an offer, the HR Advisor checks their registration and sends the new clinician's details to Clinical Services at least ten business days before the start date.
The Clinical Director confirms the clinician's sessions and sends a roster request to Practice Operations, which adds the clinician to the clinic rosters and the booking system.
